meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties with pretrained models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict molecular properties or explore ML for chemistry

howto.what: Claude 可以用 DeepChem 处理分子数据（SMILES、SDF 等），通过多种特征化方法（指纹、图特征等）将其转为数值，然后训练传统机器学习或图神经网络模型，预测分子性质（如溶解度、毒性、ADMET），也可直接使用 MoleculeNet 基准数据集和预训练模型。
howto.when: 当你要求分析分子化学数据、预测分子性质、使用特征化或图神经网络时触发。例如：提供 SMILES 列表或 CSV 文件，要求预测溶解度、毒性等。

howto.what_en: Claude can use DeepChem to load molecular data (SMILES, SDF), featurize them (fingerprints, graph features), then train traditional ML or GNN models to predict properties (solubility, toxicity, ADMET), or use MoleculeNet benchmarks and pretrained models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to process molecular data, predict properties, use featurization, or train GNNs. Typical entry: providing SMILES or CSV for property prediction.
